This repository is a a module for a game called ITGMania, a modern day rhythm game based on In The Groove. 

This module is designed to be used within SimplyLove, a theme for ITGMania.

The goal of this project is to create a module that sends scores to a cloud service, enabling community leaderboards, online tournaments, and other online features.

Keep code simple, only add comments that add value and do not describe your own thought process.

Keep data in memory and do not format as a string until needed for I/O (disk or network).
